concerns.text: Phase 8 (Ablation Study) tasks T042‑T044d produce the `ablation_results.parquet` artifact that is required by the statistical analysis tasks in Phase 7 (T032‑T036). Because Phase 7 is scheduled before Phase 8, the analysis would attempt to consume a non‑existent artifact, violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering rule. Reorder the plan so that the ablation study (Phase 8) runs before the analysis/reporting phase (Phase 7) or split the analysis into a sub‑phase that runs after ablation results are available.
